messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Ó honra e luz dos outros poetas, concede‑me o longo estudo e o grande amor que me fez buscar o teu volume.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Portuguese)**
| # | Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |---|-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | 1 | O | Vocative particle addressing abstract entities | Ó | “O” (exclamation) | OK | | 2 | de | Preposition marking possession/association | dos | “of the” | OK | | 3 | li | Definite article, masc. plural | **(included in “dos”)** | “the” (merged) | **UNNECESSARY** | | 4 | altri | Adjective specifying which poets | outros | “other” | OK | | 5 | poeti | Noun, masc. plural, object of preposition | poetas | “poets” | OK | | 6 | onore | Noun, abstract quality | honra | “honor” | OK | | 7 | e | Coordinating conjunction linking qualities | e | “and” | OK | | 8 | lume | Noun, abstract quality | luz | “light” | OK | | 9 | vagliami | Imperative verb + enclitic pronoun, request | concede‑me | “grant me” | OK | |10 | ’l | Definite article (il) | o | “the” | OK | |11 | lungo | Adjective describing extent | longo | “long” | OK | |12 | studio | Noun, scholarly effort | estudo | “study” | OK | |13 | e | Coordinating conjunction | e | “and” | OK | |14 | ’l | Definite article | o | “the” | OK | |15 | grande | Adjective qualifying intensity | grande | “great” | OK | |16 | amore | Noun, passionate feeling | amor | “love” | OK | |17 | che | Relative pronoun introducing cause clause | que | “which/that” | OK | |18 | m’ha | Enclitic pronoun + auxiliary (“mi ha”) | me fez | “made me” (combined) | OK | |19 | fatto | Past participle, causative verb | fez | “made” | OK | |20 | cercar | Infinitive “to search” | buscar | “to search” | OK | |21 | lo | Definite article, masc. singular | o | “the” | OK | |22 | tuo | Possessive adjective | teu | “your/thy” | OK | |23 | volume. | Noun, object being sought | volume. | “volume” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *li* – the separate Italian article is absorbed into the Portuguese prepositional contraction “dos”; a distinct word is not required.
No other tokens are missing, wrong, or grammatically problematic.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
